name: United Arab Emirates - Official Holidays (Multilingual: ar+en_US+th)
title: United Arab Emirates - Official Holidays (Multilingual: ar+en_US+th)
description: Comprehensive United Arab Emirates (الإمارات العربية المتحدة / al-Imarat al-Arabiya al-Muttahida) official holidays from 1972 through 2030. All vacanza supported_languages: ar, en_US, th; all supported_categories: government, optional, public (government:5 / optional:1 / public:789). Country code AE. No subdivisions in vacanza (single national list). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) via holidays.AE(years=range(1972, 2031), language=L, categories=(C,), islamic_show_estimated=True) iteration over L in ('ar', 'en_US', 'th') and C in ('government', 'optional', 'public'). Suffixes for estimated/observed dates lifted into separate boolean flags (is_estimated=511, is_observed=0). Name collisions on the same date concatenated with '; ' (vacanza native behavior). Native Arabic preserved via ensure_ascii=False.

meta.title: United Arab Emirates - Official Holidays (Multilingual: ar+en_US+th) - تحميل مجاني
meta.description: Comprehensive United Arab Emirates (الإمارات العربية المتحدة / al-Imarat al-Arabiya al-Muttahida) official holidays from 1972 through 2030. All vacanza supported_languages: ar, en_US, th; all supported_categories: government, optional, public (government:5 / optional:1 / public:789). Country code AE. No subdivisions in vacanza (single national list). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) via holidays.AE(years=range(1972, 2031), language=L, categories=(C,), islamic_show_estimated=True) iteration over L in ('ar', 'en_US', 'th') and C in ('government', 'optional', 'public'). Suffixes for estimated/observed dates lifted into separate boolean flags (is_estimated=511, is_observed=0). Name collisions on the same date concatenated with '; ' (vacanza native behavior). Native Arabic preserved via ensure_ascii=False. يحتوي على 795 سجل. تحميل بصيغ Excel, CSV, PDF.
